lessonTitle: 25. Review: power, exponential and logarithmic functions
lessonTitleEnglish: Review: power, exponential and logarithmic functions
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 12 mathematics textbooks (advanced stream)

stages.headline: Exponential and logarithmic functions increase for a > 1, decrease for 0 < a < 1 and are inverse to each other.
stages.headlineEnglish: Exponential and logarithmic functions increase for a > 1, decrease for 0 < a < 1 and are inverse to each other.

stages.headline: aᶠ = aᵍ ⇔ f = g and logₐ f = logₐ g ⇔ f = g > 0; in inequalities the sign flips when 0 < a < 1.
stages.headlineEnglish: aᶠ = aᵍ ⇔ f = g and logₐ f = logₐ g ⇔ f = g > 0; in inequalities the sign flips when 0 < a < 1.

stages.headline: Examples: /K 3^{2x - 1} K/ = 27 gives x = 2; log₂(x + 1) < 3 gives −1 < x < 7.
stages.headlineEnglish: Examples: 3^(2x − 1) = 27 gives x = 2; log₂(x + 1) < 3 gives −1 < x < 7.
